sessions.stage: Stage 1: Words for work + clear sounds
sessions.title: Words for meetings + the V and W sounds
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| agenda | uh-JEN-duh | கூட்ட நிகழ்ச்சி நிரல் | Let's start with the **agenda**. |
| clarify | KLAIR-ih-fy | தெளிவுபடுத்து | Can you **clarify** this point? |
| deadline | DED-line | கடைசி தேதி | The **deadline** is Friday. |
| update | UP-date | புதிய தகவல் | I'll give you a quick **update**. |
| priority | pry-OR-ih-tee | முன்னுரிமை | This is our top **priority**. |

### Accent: V vs W
Many Tamil speakers say **V** and **W** the same way (வ). In English they're different:
- **V**: top teeth touch your lower lip. Feel a buzz. → *very, video, voice*
- **W**: round your lips like a kiss. Teeth don't touch. → *we, work, window*

*V = மேல் பற்கள் கீழ் உதட்டைத் தொடும். W = உதடுகளை வட்டமாக்குங்கள், பற்கள் தொடாது.*

**Say these pairs slowly, then fast:**
- **v**est / **w**est
- **v**ine / **w**ine
- **v**ery **w**ell
- "**W**e **w**ill **v**isit the **v**illage on **W**ednesday."

🪞 **Mirror check:** watch your lips in a mirror. For W, your teeth must not touch your lip.

✅ **Try it today:** use *agenda* or *update* in a meeting or email.

sessions.stage: Stage 1: Words for work + clear sounds
sessions.title: Words for email + the TH sounds
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| attached | uh-TACHT | இணைக்கப்பட்ட | Please find the file **attached**. |
| regarding | rih-GAR-ding | தொடர்பாக | I'm writing **regarding** the project. |
| confirm | kun-FURM | உறுதிப்படுத்து | Can you **confirm** the time? |
| available | uh-VAY-luh-bul | கிடைக்கும் / நேரம் இருக்கும் | Are you **available** tomorrow? |
| follow up | FOL-oh up | தொடர்ந்து கேட்பது | I'll **follow up** next week. |

### Accent: TH
English has two TH sounds. Tamil speakers often say them as **த** or **ட**. Put the **tip of your tongue lightly between your teeth** and blow air.
- Soft TH (no buzz): **th**ink, **th**ree, **th**anks
- Buzzing TH: **th**is, **th**at, **th**ey

*நாக்கின் நுனியை பற்களுக்கு இடையில் வைத்து காற்றை ஊதுங்கள்.*

**Say slowly, then fast:**
- **th**ree / **t**ree
- **th**ank / **t**ank
- "**Th**ank you for **th**e **th**ree **th**ings."
- "**Th**is is **th**e **th**ird **th**ursday."

✅ **Try it today:** write one email using *regarding* and *confirm*.

sessions.stage: Stage 1: Words for work + clear sounds
sessions.title: Words for describing work + word stress
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| efficient | ih-FISH-unt | திறமையான / வேகமான | This method is more **efficient**. |
| reliable | rih-LY-uh-bul | நம்பகமான | Our system is **reliable**. |
| improve | im-PROOV | மேம்படுத்து | We need to **improve** speed. |
| feature | FEE-chur | அம்சம் | This app has a new **feature**. |
| solution | suh-LOO-shun | தீர்வு | We found a good **solution**. |

### Accent: word stress
In English, **one part of each word is louder and longer**. Saying every part equally (as in Tamil) can make words hard to understand.
*ஒவ்வொரு சொல்லிலும் ஒரு பகுதி மட்டும் சத்தமாகவும் நீளமாகவும் இருக்கும்.*

Clap on the **BIG** part:
- de-VE-lo-per · ap-pli-CA-tion · com-PU-ter
- PHO-to · pho-TO-gra-phy · pho-to-GRA-phic
- "I'm a MO-bile de-VE-lo-per."

💡 Dictionaries show the stress with a mark **ˈ** before the strong part: /dɪˈveləpər/.

✅ **Try it today:** say your job title with the right stress 5 times.

sessions.stage: Stage 1: Words for work + clear sounds
sessions.title: Words for opinions + the short and long vowels
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| suggest | sug-JEST | பரிந்துரை செய் | I **suggest** we test it first. |
| concern | kun-SURN | கவலை | My only **concern** is cost. |
| agree | uh-GREE | ஒப்புக்கொள் | I **agree** with you. |
| option | OP-shun | விருப்பம் / வழி | We have two **options**. |
| benefit | BEN-ih-fit | பயன் | The main **benefit** is speed. |

### Accent: short **i** vs long **ee**
Like Tamil **இ** (short) and **ஈ** (long), English has *ship* and *sheep*. The difference changes the meaning.
*இ (ship) மற்றும் ஈ (sheep) போல.*

**Say the pairs:**
- sh**i**p / sh**ee**p
- l**i**ve / l**ea**ve
- f**i**ll / f**ee**l
- b**i**t / b**ea**t
- "Please l**ea**ve the sh**ee**p on the sh**i**p."

✅ **Try it today:** give one opinion at work using *I suggest…* or *My concern is…*

sessions.stage: Stage 1: Words for work + clear sounds
sessions.title: Words for confidence + no extra "i" at the start
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| confident | KON-fih-dunt | தன்னம்பிக்கை உள்ள | I feel **confident** about this. |
| explain | ik-SPLAYN | விளக்கு | Let me **explain** quickly. |
| specific | spuh-SIF-ik | குறிப்பிட்ட | Can you be more **specific**? |
| straightforward | strayt-FOR-wurd | எளிமையான | The process is **straightforward**. |
| exactly | ig-ZAKT-lee | சரியாக | That's **exactly** right. |

### Accent: words starting with **s + consonant**
Tamil speakers sometimes add a small "i" before words like *school* (*iskool*) or *station* (*istation*). Start directly with the **s**, like a snake: **sss**-chool.
*"இஸ்கூல்" அல்ல, "ஸ்கூல்". பாம்பு போல "ஸ்ஸ்" என்று தொடங்குங்கள்.*

**Say slowly, then fast:**
- **s**chool · **s**tation · **s**pecific · **s**tart · **s**trong
- "**S**tart the **s**pecific **s**tep at the **s**tation."

✅ **Try it today:** say *Let me explain* before explaining something at work.

sessions.stage: Stage 2: Words for meetings + the schwa sound
sessions.title: Starting a meeting + The schwa /ə/ (the lazy "uh")
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| get started | get STAR-tid | தொடங்குவோம் | Shall we **get started**? |
| attend | uh-TEND | கலந்துகொள் | Thanks for **attending** today. |
| purpose | PUR-pus | நோக்கம் | The **purpose** of this call is planning. |
| brief | BREEF | சுருக்கமான | I'll be **brief**. |
| discuss | dis-KUS | விவாதி | Let's **discuss** the timeline. |

### Accent: The schwa /ə/ (the lazy "uh")
The most common English sound is a short, relaxed "uh" in weak parts of words: a-GO, BA-na-na → buh-NA-nuh.
*ஆங்கிலத்தின் மிகப் பொதுவான ஒலி "அ" போன்ற மெல்லிய ஒலி. அழுத்தம் இல்லாத பகுதியில் வரும்.*

**Say slowly, then fast:**
- a-bout → uh-BOUT
- to-day → tuh-DAY
- "Let's get uh-LONG to the uh-JEN-duh."

✅ **Try it today:** Open a meeting with "Shall we get started?"
*இன்று இதைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.*

sessions.stage: Stage 2: Words for meetings + the schwa sound
sessions.title: Giving updates + Schwa in "-tion" and "-ment"
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| progress | PRO-gres | முன்னேற்றம் | We made good **progress** this week. |
| on track | on TRAK | சரியான பாதையில் | The project is **on track**. |
| delay | dih-LAY | தாமதம் | There's a small **delay**. |
| complete | kum-PLEET | முடி | We **completed** the login screen. |
| pending | PEN-ding | நிலுவையில் | Two tasks are still **pending**. |

### Accent: Schwa in "-tion" and "-ment"
Endings like -tion and -ment are weak: "shun", "munt", never "shan" or "ment" with full vowels.
*-tion = "ஷன்", -ment = "மன்ட்" மெல்லியதாக.*

**Say slowly, then fast:**
- in-for-MA-tion → in-fer-MAY-shun
- de-VEL-op-ment → dih-VEL-up-munt
- "The man-uh-JUR-munt wants more in-fer-MAY-shun."

✅ **Try it today:** Give a one-line status update using "progress".
*இன்று இதைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.*

sessions.stage: Stage 2: Words for meetings + the schwa sound
sessions.title: Asking questions + Weak "to", "for", "of"
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| question | KWES-chun | கேள்வி | I have a quick **question**. |
| mean | MEEN | அர்த்தம் கொள் | What do you **mean** by that? |
| example | ig-ZAM-pul | உதாரணம் | Can you give an **example**? |
| detail | DEE-tail | விவரம் | Let's go into more **detail**. |
| point | POYNT | கருத்து | That's a good **point**. |

### Accent: Weak "to", "for", "of"
Small words are usually weak: to → tuh, for → fer, of → uv.
*சிறிய சொற்கள் மெல்லியதாக: to→டு, for→ஃபர், of→அவ்.*

**Say slowly, then fast:**
- I want tuh go
- This is fer you
- A cup uv tea

✅ **Try it today:** Ask one question in a meeting starting with "Could you…"
*இன்று இதைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.*

sessions.stage: Stage 2: Words for meetings + the schwa sound
sessions.title: Agreeing and disagreeing + Weak "and", "but", "can"
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| see your point | SEE yer POYNT | உங்கள் கருத்து புரிகிறது | I **see your point**, but cost matters. |
| however | how-EV-er | இருப்பினும் | **However**, we need more time. |
| fair | FAIR | நியாயமான | That's a **fair** question. |
| alternative | ol-TUR-nuh-tiv | மாற்று | Is there an **alternative**? |
| approach | uh-PROHCH | அணுகுமுறை | I like this **approach**. |

### Accent: Weak "and", "but", "can"
and → un, but → but (short), can → kun in sentences. Strong only when stressed.
*and→அன், can→கன் வாக்கியத்தில் மெல்லியதாக.*

**Say slowly, then fast:**
- bread un butter
- I kun do it
- You and me → you-un-ME

✅ **Try it today:** Disagree politely once: "I see your point, but…"
*இன்று இதைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.*

sessions.stage: Stage 2: Words for meetings + the schwa sound
sessions.title: Ending a meeting + Sentence stress on key words
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| wrap up | RAP up | முடித்துக்கொள் | Let's **wrap up**. |
| summary | SUM-uh-ree | சுருக்கம் | Here's a quick **summary**. |
| action item | AK-shun eye-tum | செய்ய வேண்டிய பணி | Each person has one **action item**. |
| next steps | NEKST steps | அடுத்த படிகள் | Let's agree on **next steps**. |
| appreciate | uh-PREE-shee-ate | பாராட்டு / நன்றி | I **appreciate** your time. |

### Accent: Sentence stress on key words
Stress the important words (nouns, verbs). Small words stay quick and weak.
*முக்கிய சொற்களை மட்டும் அழுத்தமாகச் சொல்லுங்கள்.*

**Say slowly, then fast:**
- "Let's MEET on FRI-day."
- "SEND me the RE-port."
- "THANKS for your TIME."

✅ **Try it today:** End a meeting with "Let's wrap up."
*இன்று இதைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.*

sessions.stage: Stage 3: Words for describing problems + the "Z" sound
sessions.title: Reporting a bug + Z vs S
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| issue | ISH-oo | பிரச்சனை | We found an **issue** in the app. |
| occur | uh-KUR | நிகழ் | The error **occurs** on login. |
| crash | KRASH | செயலிழப்பு | The app **crashes** on Android. |
| reproduce | ree-pruh-DOOS | மீண்டும் உருவாக்கு | I can't **reproduce** the bug. |
| cause | KAWZ | காரணம் | What's the root **cause**? |

### Accent: Z vs S
Tamil has no Z. Make S, then add a buzz from your throat: zzz like a bee.
*Z = "ஸ்" ஒலியுடன் தொண்டையில் அதிர்வு (தேனீ போல "ஸ்ஸ்ஸ்").*

**Say slowly, then fast:**
- zoo / Sue
- zip / sip
- "Zero issues is easy."

✅ **Try it today:** Report one issue using "occurs".
*இன்று இதைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.*

sessions.stage: Stage 3: Words for describing problems + the "Z" sound
sessions.title: Explaining impact + -s endings that sound like Z
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| affect | uh-FEKT | பாதிப்பு ஏற்படுத்து | It **affects** all users. |
| impact | IM-pakt | தாக்கம் | The **impact** is small. |
| critical | KRIT-ih-kul | மிக முக்கியமான | This is a **critical** bug. |
| minor | MY-ner | சிறிய | It's a **minor** issue. |
| risk | RISK | ஆபத்து | There's a **risk** of data loss. |

### Accent: -s endings that sound like Z
Plural -s after a voiced sound is /z/: users → USE-erz, systems → SIS-tumz.
*பன்மை -s பல சமயம் "ஸ்" அல்ல "ஸ்" அதிர்வுடன் (z).*

**Say slowly, then fast:**
- users
- servers
- emails
- "The users lose files."

✅ **Try it today:** Explain impact: "This affects…"
*இன்று இதைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.*

sessions.stage: Stage 3: Words for describing problems + the "Z" sound
sessions.title: Fixing things + Final consonants (don't drop them)
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| fix | FIKS | சரி செய் | I'll **fix** it today. |
| workaround | WURK-uh-round | தற்காலிக தீர்வு | Here's a **workaround**. |
| patch | PACH | சிறு திருத்தம் | We'll release a **patch**. |
| resolve | rih-ZOLV | தீர் | The issue is **resolved**. |
| test | TEST | சோதி | Please **test** it again. |

### Accent: Final consonants (don't drop them)
Pronounce the last sound clearly: fixed (fikst), helped (helpt), asked (askt).
*கடைசி ஒலியை விடாதீர்கள்: fixed = ஃபிக்ஸ்ட்.*

**Say slowly, then fast:**
- fixed
- checked
- asked
- "I fixed it and tested it."

✅ **Try it today:** Say "I've fixed it" clearly to someone.
*இன்று இதைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.*

sessions.stage: Stage 3: Words for describing problems + the "Z" sound
sessions.title: Investigating + -ed endings: t, d, id
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| investigate | in-VES-tih-gate | ஆராய் | We're **investigating** the error. |
| log | LOG | பதிவு | Check the **logs**. |
| check | CHEK | சரிபார் | I **checked** the server. |
| identify | eye-DEN-tih-fy | கண்டறி | We **identified** the problem. |
| trace | TRAYS | கண்டுபிடி | Let's **trace** the request. |

### Accent: -ed endings: t, d, id
After p,k,s,sh,ch → /t/ (stopped); after t,d → /id/ (wanted); others → /d/ (called).
*-ed: "ட்", "ட்", அல்லது "இட்".*

**Say slowly, then fast:**
- stopped (stopt)
- called (kawld)
- wanted (WON-tid)

✅ **Try it today:** Describe what you checked yesterday with -ed verbs.
*இன்று இதைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.*

sessions.stage: Stage 3: Words for describing problems + the "Z" sound
sessions.title: Preventing problems + Stress in 2-syllable nouns vs verbs
sessions.content:
### New words
| Word | Say it | பொருள் | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| prevent | prih-VENT | தடு | Tests **prevent** bugs. |
| monitor | MON-ih-ter | கண்காணி | We **monitor** the servers. |
| alert | uh-LURT | எச்சரிக்கை | We got an **alert** at night. |
| backup | BAK-up | காப்புப் பிரதி | Do we have a **backup**? |
| increase | in-KREES (v) | அதிகரி | Traffic will **increase**. |

### Accent: Stress in 2-syllable nouns vs verbs
Many words change: a REcord (noun) / to reCORD (verb), a PREsent / to preSENT.
*பெயர்ச்சொல் முன்பகுதி, வினை பின்பகுதி அழுத்தம்.*

**Say slowly, then fast:**
- REcord / reCORD
- OBject / obJECT
- INcrease / inCREASE

✅ **Try it today:** Use "increase" as noun and verb in two sentences.
*இன்று இதைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.*
